notes.title: The Age of Rime has been added to the latest remake of Myst!
notes.content:
The fan-favorite Age of Rime has been added as a free update to our latest remake of [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1255560/Myst/]Myst[/url][/i]. This new version of Rime includes all-new narrative beats, new lore, and new sights to behold, ensuring that [i]Myst[/i] (2021) is now the definitive and complete way to experience the story and worlds of [i]Myst[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33662314/152c49908c38256af0303ea2b22a63aa76f25999.png[/img]

Following the completion of the main story in [i]Myst[/i], or upon loading a completed game, a new journey awaits you somewhere on Myst Island.

The Age of Rime introduces players to the snowy, mountainous seascape that Atrus and his family would visit in years past, before the events of [i]Myst[/i] and [i]Riven[/i] upended their lives. Sweeping vistas, beautiful ice structures, and fantastical natural phenomena await new visitors. This breathtaking new Age also houses a detailed laboratory space where bold experiments were made, delving into the mysterious nature of Linking Books themselves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33662314/69c5f19317e707b9be3367ba1de7c77e789dd122.png[/img]

You can find [i]Myst [/i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1255560/Myst/]here[/url]. [i]Myst[/i] is also a part of multiple bundles that will provide a discount based on the purchase of other games in them:
[list]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/41988/Myst__Riven_The_Definitive_Collection/]Myst & Riven: The Definitive Collection[/url] - a bundle with the latest remakes of both [i]Myst[/i] (2021) and [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1712350/Riven/]Riven[/url][/i] (2024).
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/37135/Myst_30th_Anniversary_Collection/]Myst 30th Anniversary Collection[/url] - a bundle of all currently available Myst games released on or before 2023, the 30th anniversary of [i]Myst[/i].
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/29645/Myst_Through_the_Ages/]Myst: Through the Ages[/url] - a bundle that contains [i]Myst: Masterpiece Edition[/i], [i]realMyst: Masterpiece Edition[/i], and the latest remake of [i]Myst[/i].
[/list]
Thank you for your support of our games!

notes.title: Cyan Reveals Development of Myst for VR
notes.content:
We are so excited to share this news about a new Myst game with you! 

This has been kept close to our chest for a while now, but now that the cat is officially out of the bag, we can finally talk about it… it’s a brand new version of Myst, built for the first time with VR in mind. Coming soon, Myst will be available to play in both 2D and VR! 

Check out our teaser trailer!

[previewyoutube=mtkJkQ3JztY;full][/previewyoutube]

This Myst has been fully redesigned and created from the ground up using the Unreal Engine, the same engine we used on Obduction. Many of the puzzles have been reimagined and engineered to include optional puzzle randomization and also keep accessibility in mind. 

The pictures speak for themselves, go check them out and wishlist now on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1255560/Myst/]Steam[/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3954498/afb2d2cc2844993b4050a0e2f56b058dc8101121.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3954498/5fbf0ab3ed12443260601a3129248048eb9237fd.jpg[/img][/url]

One more thing, 

Right now you can get any game from the Myst series for 50% off, and 10% off extra as a part of the Myst 25th anniversary collection if you complete the set. It's a great time to get back into Myst. Thanks, 

The Cyan Team

notes.title: Myst 25th Anniversary Release
notes.content:
We are very excited to be releasing Myst IV: Revelation on the day of Myst’s 25th Anniversary on Steam!

Today’s release of Myst III: Exile and Myst IV: Revelation completes the 7-game Myst Collection in digital format.  We hope you enjoy the game whether you are a first-time player or a returning player who is feeling a little nostalgic.

Should you have something you would like to report regarding Myst IV: Revelation, please contact us directly at support@cyan.com. We would be happy to assist you.

[u]Release Notes:[/u]

Myst IV: Revelation is available in 6 languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, and Dutch.  To access language selection after the game has been downloaded, right-click on the game in your Library, select Properties, select the ‘Language tab’, and then select the language option of your choice from the drop-down menu.  Language selection can also be changed via the in-game options menu. 

Windows 10 compatibility update.

Please make sure your anti-virus program is not blocking the game from launching.  You may need to modify the settings in your anti-virus to grant permission to allow the file "myst4.exe'  to run. This file is located in C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Myst IV Revelation\bin\Myst4  (for a default install).

Make sure you have the latest drivers installed for your graphics setup, otherwise you may experience crashing or oddities with the graphics.

[u]Known Issues:[/u]

We are currently investigating an issue with some players experiencing a crash on launch.  The crash happens just after the screen resolution change. If this crash happens to you, (1) check to make sure you have the latest audio and graphic drivers installed for your system and (2) make sure your anti-virus program is not blocking the game from starting up (see above notes).  If the game still crashes on launch after trying the suggestions above, please contact our support team and include the dxdiag report for your computer.

The Steam overlay in game only opens in 4:3. Myst IV supports the range of resolutions available in the 4:3 aspect ratio [only] and the game plays in full-screen mode [only].  The Windows command to place the game in a window, Alt+Enter, does not have any effect on this game.

Starting the game without speakers requires a game restart to enable the audio if speakers plugged in after start.
